Core Focus:
Research Engine is a partnership dedicated to advancing the field of additive manufacturing through innovative solutions in material extrusion and the use of high-performance polymers. Our expertise focuses on niche extreme thermoplastics from ultra soft TPEs to high performance materials.
Specialization:
We are pioneers in Fused Granulate Fabrication (FGF), a material extrusion 3D printing technology that utilizes thermoplastic pellets instead of traditional filaments. Our approach is versatile, adaptable to both large-scale industrial applications and small-scale precision manufacturing, allowing us to push the boundaries of what’s possible in additive manufacturing.
Research Engine’s process harnesses all available thermoplastics, from conventional polymers to advanced high-performance materials such as PEEK, and elastomers. We specialize in optimizing these materials for use in demanding environments, including applications requiring high-temperature resistance and extreme flexibility.
Key Areas of Expertise:
- Material Extrusion: Cutting-edge solutions in fused granulate fabrication, offering efficiency and precision in 3D printing.
- High-Performance Polymers: Engineering thermoplastics that withstand extreme conditions, including heat, mechanical stress, and chemical exposure.
- Additive Manufacturing: Focus on advanced 3D printing techniques that deliver high precision, tailored for both prototyping and production-scale use.
- High Temperature Applications: Expertise in materials and processes designed for high-temperature environments, ensuring stability and performance.
- Ultra-Soft & Elastomeric Materials: Precision fabrication of soft, flexible materials for specialized applications (such as large expansion, 3D printed inflatables) requiring adaptability and durability.
- System Modeling & Mechanical Engineering: Integrated design and system modelling capabilities to optimize the entire manufacturing process from material selection to final part production.
Vision:
At Research Engine, our vision is to drive next-generation manufacturing solutions by enabling the use of advanced materials and innovative extrusion technologies. We are committed to pushing the limits of 3D printing and transforming how industries approach high-precision fabrication.
By combining our expertise in high-performance materials and fused granulate fabrication, we aim to deliver practical, scalable solutions that meet the complex needs of aerospace, automotive, medical, and industrial sectors.

entityName: Burgas State University Prof. Dr Asen Zlatarov
entityDescription:
Prof. Dr. Assen Zlatarov University is the only state university in Southeastern Bulgaria. It was founded on 6thOctober 1963 by Decree № 162 of the Council of Ministers as the Higher Institute of Chemical Technology. Five years later, the Institute was renamed the Higher Institute of Chemical Technology "Prof. Dr. Asen Zlatarov", which forever links it with the name of its patron. In 1995, by a decision of the National Assembly, it was established as “Prof. Dr. Assen Zlatarov” University.
Education at the University is carried out in five faculties - Faculty of Technical Sciences, Faculty of Natural Sciences, Faculty of Social Sciences, Faculty of Public Health and Health Care and Faculty of Medicine. It comprises three colleges - the Technical College, the Medical College and the College of Tourism and two departments - the Department of Language Teaching and the Department of Qualification and Professional Development of Teaching Professionals (DQPDP).
Education at “Prof. Dr. Assen Zlatarov” University is carried out in 18 professional fields in 45 accredited Bachelor and over 30 Master programs.
The Central Research Laboratory and the Electronic Computing Centre occupy a worthy place in the structure of the University. Students studying at the University acquire the educational qualification degrees of "Professional Bachelor", "Bachelor" and "Master", as well as the scientific and educational degree "Doctor".
The University has over 320 highly qualified lecturers, 127 of whom are habilitated. The organization and management of the educational process at the University is in accordance with the European requirements and criteria for a quality educational and research process. The University system for evaluation and maintenance of the quality of education has been developed. In terms of the quality of scientific research the University is ranked among the first in Bulgaria according to the Hirsch system for contribution to science. In pursuance of the management's policy of rejuvenating and improving the qualifications of the academic staff, the practice of announcing competitions at all levels - from "assistant" to "professor" - has been established.
Prof. Dr. Assen Zlatarov University has modern necessary equipment, which is in accordance with the state requirements for high quality education. It consists of six academic buildings, a sports facility, three student hostels, three student canteens and a medical service centre. The bedding stock of the student hostels enables accommodation for all students who are not residents of Burgas.
The library and information complex includes the Central Library and three branches. The library and information complex provides materials from a wide range of fields of knowledge - social, economic, humanities and technical sciences. The reading rooms are equipped with 150 seats for reading. Access to the scientific databases Scopus, ScienceDirect, EmBase, Web of Knowledge is provided.
The academic management makes systematic efforts for the maintenance, expansion and effective use of the available necessary equipment, its modernization and renewal.
The University has established active scientific relations with institutes and universities from England, France, Germany, Russia, Romania, Turkey, Spain, Italy, Hungary, Serbia, Poland, Slovenia, Slovakia, etc. They create opportunities for scientific specializations and teaching practice of lecturers and students, for exchange of lecturers, teaching and scientific literature.
The motto of the Burgas State University ''Prof. Dr. Assen Zlatarov'' is: "CONTINUITY, INNOVATION, GROWTH, SUSTAINABLE DEVELOPMENT".

entityDescription:
Bar.on is building the "Spotify for (fermented) drinks". 

We're pioneering a new, sustainable distribution model for fermented drinks, avoiding the shipment of billions of liters of water across the globe and therefore significantly minimizing the industry's ecological footprint as well as saving huge shipping costs. Our company is on a mission to transform the distribution of fermented drinks through innovative dispensers - a hardware platform that instantly crafts high-quality, customizable drinks on demand. 

Bar.on specializes in fermentation analogues, creating beverages with a texture and mouthfeel far more complex than typical sodas. From non-alcoholic beers to functional beverages enriched with adaptogens and nootropics, for example, Bar.on’s technology is redefining how people experience their favorite drinks. Currently, we focus on four main categories: non-alcoholic beer, cold brew coffee, fermented ice tea, and kombucha, with non-alcoholic wines in the pipeline for next year. 

The Problem: The beverage distribution industry is inherently unsustainable. Every year, billions of liters of water are shipped across the globe in the form of beverages, contributing to massive carbon emissions, excessive packaging waste and significant environmental degradation. Despite the growing demand for more sustainable practices, the industry remains heavily reliant on outdated distribution methods that prioritize volume over ecological responsibility. 
Our Solution: Bar.on's dispensers are poised to revolutionize the industry by eliminating the need for global beverage transportation. Our cutting-edge technology enables the on-site production of beverages, instantly mixing high-quality ingredients into fresh, fully customizable drinks. By digitizing the beverage production process and using advanced molecular mixing technology based on a set of flavor cartridges, we ensure superior taste and quality while drastically reducing the environmental impact. 
This approach minimizes packaging waste, cuts down on transportation emissions and significantly lowers the carbon footprint of the entire beverage supply chain. Additionally, Bar.on's solutions offer valuable data capture and community-building opportunities, providing insights that further enhance consumer engagement and satisfaction.

The automotive industry is undergoing a monumental shift towards e-mobility, with significant challenges centered around the vehicle’s battery. Issues such as long charging times, high costs, limited range, and safety risks are not just inconvenient – they’re major barriers to widespread adoption. While many companies focus on optimizing battery cell chemistry, the optimization of everything surrounding the cell remains largely untapped. This approach offers significant cost savings while achieving similar benefits.
This is where ivilion comes in. Our revolutionary battery pack design features a patented load-bearing cooling structure that enables rapid charging in under ten minutes, substantial cost reductions, enhanced safety, and extended vehicle range.
To enter the market gradually, ivilion offers engineering and prototyping services as an initial step. Utilizing a fully digitalized, model-based design process allows us to respond agilely to individual customer needs and develop tailored solutions. For mass production, we rely on a licensing model and leverage existing production capacities within the supplier industry.
ivilion’s vision is to become the go-to provider for top-tier battery pack solutions, thereby accelerating the transition to electric mobility.
